ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High macro-level contrast; approximately 55-60% low-intensity (black/dark grey) pixels concentrated in the central peduncle attachment and trailing margins, with 40-45% high-intensity (white/cream) pixels distributed across the lateral lobes.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Two primary high-intensity contiguous blobs located on the lateral lobes. The left lobe exhibits a fragmented, mottled light-colored geometric area from mid-span to the tip. The right lobe contains a more expansive and solid high-intensity region extending from the interior mid-section to the distal margin, interrupted by isolated low-intensity focal spots.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with a calculated vertex angle of approximately 62 degrees and a bounding-box depth extending roughly 15% into the fluke's vertical span.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations with pixel amplitudes of 3-12 pixels along the continuous trailing boundary; serration density and height increase significantly as the contour approaches the lateral tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetrical convex sweep from the median notch radiating outward, transitioning to a slight concave oscillation near the lateral termini.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense, roughly circular clusters of textured, high-contrast tan and brown pixels at both extreme lateral tips. Numerous small, dark-intensity circular spots (mottling) are mapped across the light-intensity fields of both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Several distinct, unaligned vertical linear pixel disruptions (dark rake marks) are visible cutting through the light-pigmented surface on the distal half of the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent biological encrustations (sessile barnacle colonies) forming raised, irregular textured masses at the extreme lateral margins of both lobes.
other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced yellowish-tan pixel hue within the high-intensity light regions, specifically on the inner-mid section of the right lobe, diverging from the standard white pigmentation.
